title: The Effect of Smartphone-Based Recording Offer on Patient Satisfaction in Orthopedic Care
official: The Effect of Smartphone-Based Recording Offer on Patient Satisfaction in Orthopedic Care
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine patient satisfaction with orthopedic preoperative encounter based on offer to record the encounter on patient personal smartphone.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients presenting to RUHS for preoperative orthopedic evaluation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients without smartphones
